_doc: Shaped anatomical primitives for the 21 canonical regions.
ONE primitive type - a superquadric evaluated in a muscle-local frame:
|u/ru|^p + |v/rv|^p + |w/rw|^p <= 1
with a linear taper of (rv,rw) along u and a linear shear of v along u.
That single form expresses everything the vocabulary needed:
p=2, roughly equal radii      -> rounded cap        (deltoids)
p=2, one long radius          -> capsule            (biceps, calves)
p=5..8                        -> rounded box        (abdominals)
taper -> 0 along u            -> triangular sweep   (lats)
shear != 0                    -> diagonal boundary  (lower pec)
FRAMES (all bilateral rules are written once and mirrored automatically):
torso  u = lateral (outward from the midline), v = anterior, w = superior
arm    u = shoulder joint -> wrist,  v = anterior, w = perpendicular
leg    u = hip joint -> ankle,       v = anterior, w = lateral
ANCHORS are named points measured on the mesh, never literals.
Lengths are expressed as fractions: 'H' body height, 'TW' torso half-width
at the anchor height, 'AL' arm length, 'LL' leg length.
PRECEDENCE: regions are evaluated in ascending 'priority'. A vertex already
claimed by a lower number is never overwritten. This is explicit, not
last-rule-wins. 'excludes' additionally removes named part-sets.

regions.name: Front Shoulders
regions.note: anterior deltoid: rounded cap over the joint

regions.name: Lateral Shoulders
regions.note: lateral deltoid: outermost cap

regions.name: Rear Shoulders
regions.note: posterior deltoid: rounded cap

regions.name: Biceps
regions.note: anterior upper-arm capsule, distal to the deltoid

regions.name: Triceps
regions.note: posterior upper-arm mass

regions.name: Forearms
regions.note: elbow to wrist, tapering; hand excluded

regions.name: Upper Chest
regions.note: clavicular head: curved superior/medial border

regions.name: Middle Chest
regions.note: sternal head: broad central mass at the nipple line

regions.name: Lower Chest
regions.note: costal head: shear gives the diagonal inferior border

regions.name: Traps
regions.note: superior trapezius: central mass tapering outward

regions.name: Upper Back
regions.note: rhomboid field between the scapulae: broad rounded box

regions.name: Lats
regions.note: triangular sweep: taper 0.30 narrows toward the waist

regions.name: Lower Back
regions.note: erector spinae: tapered posterior column

regions.name: Upper Abs
regions.note: upper rectus block

regions.name: Middle Abs
regions.note: mid rectus block at the navel

regions.name: Lower Abs
regions.note: lower rectus block, narrowing to the pelvis

regions.name: Obliques
regions.note: external oblique: narrow diagonal flank strip, outboard of the rectus

regions.name: Glutes
regions.note: broad rounded posterior pelvic mass

regions.name: Quads
regions.note: anterior thigh mass, tapering to the knee

regions.name: Hamstrings
regions.note: posterior thigh capsule starting below the gluteal fold

regions.name: Calves
regions.note: gastrocnemius/soleus: POSTERIOR lower leg only. The 21-region taxonomy has no tibialis anterior, so the anterior shin is left UNASSIGNED rather than mislabelled as calf.
